name: Derek Goldfuss
education: Burns Junior/Senior High School; Laramie County Community College graduate, class of 2019 (served as student-government president). At commencement he said he would continue his education in molecular biology; a later completed degree in that field was not confirmed in that article.
background: A May 2019 WTE commencement story identified Derek Goldfuss as president of LCCC’s student government, a Burns Junior/Senior High graduate who returned to college after finding work and daily life unfulfilling, and a 2019 LCCC graduate who planned to continue studying molecular biology. He received the president’s plaque for service to the college and mentioned work on the Pathfinder Building dedication, the Ludden Library reopening, and student-club budgets.
